note: Mastery Chain links the simulator models (sim/chain.py; docs/SIM.md 'Mastery Chain links'). Values per link by material, bronze / silver / gold / corrupted: the wiki's Mastery Chain page (rev 32179, 2026-08-11; outlands_web.db docs 'Mastery Chain'), its '~' values exact as 1 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.625 x bronze. A link type adds its links' values; 'points' are skill points, the rest shares (0.02 = 2 %). Up to 10 links of a type (15 with a redline upgrade) and up to 30 in a chain (wiki); a character installs as many as his unlocked slots (Logan: tamer/logan_wolf.json chain.limit). Each `effect` says where the simulator applies it; [INFERENCE] marks a rule the wiki doesn't state.

effective_barding.effect: adds to the effective barding skill E (80 skill + the instrument's quality + these): the success chance (+1 point a point), the durations and the songs (World._bard, _song; docs/SIM.md 'Barding from the effective skill')

barding_durations.effect: Discordance, Peacemaking and Provocation last x (1 + total) [INFERENCE: the 15-minute songs are not a skill's effect and stay]

break_ignore.effect: a Barding Break about to end our peace or provocation is avoided with this chance ('Barding break avoided for <name>', the live text). Live Logan saw 53 such lines with no link of this type (2026-10-12..26): a base chance the simulator doesn't model, so this adds to 0. The 'reset' half is not modelled

damage_to_barded.effect: multiplicative (wiki): our and our pets' damage on a creature we discorded, pacified or provoked x (1 + total) [INFERENCE: the pets' damage counts, as the songs' does]

follower_damage.effect: additive (wiki): in the pets' static damage pool (sim/pets.build_pet)

follower_damage_resistance.effect: in the pets' static damage resistance, with the Command aspect's (at most 75 % with the perks)

follower_attack_speed.effect: in the pets' attack speed bonus with their level's and the Command aspect's (at most 50 %, the rest damage, #4661)

follower_healing_received.effect: every heal on a pet x (1 + this + the perks' heal bonuses) [INFERENCE: the same pool as Mending, Swarm, Menagerie]

follower_accuracy_defense.effect: a melee pet's chance to hit + this, a monster's melee chance to hit a pet - this [INFERENCE: points of hit chance]

alchemy_healing_veterinary.effect: effective Veterinary: the vet supplies' heals (Vet / 100 x ...) and the pets' 10 % x Vet / 100 damage [INFERENCE: 'effective skill links boost the bonuses you get from those skills in combat', wiki]. Its Alchemy (the heal potions' numbers are measured, not a formula) and Healing (no bandages) don't apply

healing_received.effect: every heal on Logan (potions, vet supplies) x (1 + total) [INFERENCE: additive with the Song of Peacemaking's]

damage_resistance.effect: on Logan: what he takes x (1 - total - the codex's) [INFERENCE: one pool]

physical_damage_resistance.effect: as damage_resistance, on Logan's physical hits (melee, feeds, charges, a transfixed copy's)

spell_damage_resistance.effect: as damage_resistance, on the spells that reach Logan

gold_drop.effect: the gold in a corpse x (1 + total)

unmodelled.Damage Dealt By Player: Logan doesn't fight; his only damage is through his pets
unmodelled.Effective Magic Resist Skill: the spells on Logan are measured numbers, no resist roll
unmodelled.Special Loot Chance: no special loot in the simulator
unmodelled.Rare Loot Chance: no rare loot in the simulator
